hero_prop_criteria.center_of_focus: The story, a shot or a character's attention centres on the object.
hero_prop_criteria.high_frequency: The object is present in more than one scene/act.
hero_prop_criteria.transfer: The object passes between two characters.
hero_prop_criteria.actively_handled: A character physically interacts with the object (holds, uses, repairs...).

scenes.heading: EXT. SABA ELIOR’S COURTYARD — LATE MORNING

hero_props.name: Yonah's lunch bundle of five loaves and two fish
hero_props.description: Yonah's small lunch bundle: five barley loaves and two fish. It is given to Andrew and Jesus, multiplied into bread and fish for the crowd, and continues as leftover pieces gathered afterward.
hero_props.reason: This is the central miracle prop: it is introduced, debated, offered, received by Jesus, multiplied, distributed, gathered as leftovers, and thematically compared to Miri's cakes.

hero_props.name: Miri's cloth bundle of honey-date cakes
aliases: one whole cake and half of another
hero_props.description: Miri's cloth-wrapped set of three honey-date cakes. The same set is guarded, reconsidered after the loaves-and-fish story, then divided and shared with Tav, Nim, and Miri herself.
hero_props.reason: The cakes are Miri's concrete test of generosity, recur from cold open through ending, are repeatedly handled, and are finally given away.

hero_props.name: Miracle distribution and leftover baskets
hero_props.description: The baskets used to hold, pass, distribute, and gather the multiplied bread and fish; this includes the basket placed in Miri's hands and the twelve leftover baskets.
hero_props.reason: The baskets visibly carry the miracle through the crowd, are passed and received, and become proof of abundance when twelve remain full.

hero_props.name: The small loaves-and-fish scroll
hero_props.description: A small scroll tied with barley-colored cord and sealed with a loaf-and-two-fish mark; when opened, it transports Miri and Nim into the feeding story, then glows on its shelf.
hero_props.reason: It is the gateway prop for the story world, is selected and opened by Saba, and recurs after the vision.

hero_props.name: Tav's broken toy cart and repair peg
hero_props.description: Tav's toy cart with a loose wheel; Miri helps repair it using a small peg that Nim noses toward her.
hero_props.reason: The cart appears before and after Miri's change of heart, and its repair becomes a second act of generosity. The peg is passed to Miri and used to fix the wheel.
